quest.title: Outspoken Linling
quest.description: Linling from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Manager Xiao
dialogues.text: "Peaceful as a Slumbering Mountain"... that's pretty good!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Hmm, I suppose I should go find them for more inspiration...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I'm helping some people think of suitable things to write on their Xiao Lanterns.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: You know how everyone releases Xiao Lanterns during the Lantern Rite festival, right? Well, they also write things on the lanterns too, like wishes, or blessings, and the like...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: To fit the festive atmosphere, some people like to try and give their written wishes and blessings some... umm, you know...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Some literary flair, you know what I mean?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Bibo, Manager Xiao, and Degui have all asked me to spruce up their festive wishes with some literary talent and write them on Xiao Lanterns for them.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: But I certainly won't be inspired to write anything decent by just staying cooped up here.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: So I was thinking I'd prepare the Xiao Lanterns first, then go observe the people that have requested the lanterns. This way, I'll be able to better tailor each person's wishes to their needs.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: But I'm not very good at making Xiao Lanterns...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Oh, would you? Then if you could, please help me make three Xiao Lanterns.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Once the lanterns are ready, we'll go see our patrons to find some inspiration on what to write for their wishes.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Hehe, I already have some ideas in mind, they just need a little... creative zest!

choices.text: I'm quite a pro at this.

talks.objective: Give three Xiao Lanterns to Linling

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: How are the Xiao Lanterns coming along? Have you prepared three of them?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Good, these will be perfect. Let's start by finding Manager Xiao, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: There's Manager Xiao, let's watch from here and see what he's up to.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Hmm, let me think... I know Manager Xiao pretty well, it won't take me long to write his wish.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Here, how does this sound...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: "A shriveled old man with the heart of a shark"...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: "But underneath his impersonal cloak lies a warm and caring heart."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: I've even come up with a title, too... "A Nice Person, Indeed."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: So? Pretty fitting, don't you think? Even though Manager Xiao appears to be pretty fierce, he's actually a nice person...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you have any alternatives to consider as well?

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: No, just this one... I can't seem to think of how to continue with this theme, though.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Would you like to give it a try?

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: The first phrase is "Down at the dock, his steely gaze inspires awe in the hearts of the young"...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "But he sleeps like a rock and snores like a bear when the working day is done."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Hmm, not bad... That'll do just fine. Now all we need is a title...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh... "Peaceful as a Slumbering Mountain"...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Oh! I never would have guessed you had such literary talent. These lines are perfect!

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Just wait a moment while I write this on the Xiao Lantern...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Alright, that does it. Let's go give the lantern to Manager Xiao.

talks.objective: Give a Xiao Lantern to Manager Xiao

dialogues.speaker: Manager Xiao
dialogues.text: Ah, hello Linling. Do you need anything?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Remember how you asked me to come up with some lines for you on a Xiao Lantern? Well, the Traveler and I have just finished preparing everything.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: See, we've even written the words on the Xiao Lantern for you.

dialogues.speaker: Manager Xiao
dialogues.text: Oh thank you very much, let me read it...

dialogues.speaker: Manager Xiao
dialogues.text: "Down at the dock, his steely gaze inspires awe in the hearts of the young"... "But he sleeps like a rock and snores like a bear when the working day is done."

dialogues.speaker: Manager Xiao
dialogues.text: "Peaceful as a Slumbering Mountain"... Hehe, that's pretty good, thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: You're welcome, Manager Xiao. I still have another verse that I wrote myself. Here, let me read it to you...

choices.text: Alright, I think we'd better be going now! We've still got other people to see, you know...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Oh, right! Well then, our next patron is Degui. Let's go.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: The verses for Degui will be my finest work yet! I'll tell you more once we find him.

choices.text: Um, we still have more lanterns to deliver!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I see Degui over there. Let's observe for a minute, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Have you ever met Degui? I know him best by the drinks he sells in his shop...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I've actually already thought about what I would write for him. Here, have a listen:

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: "Third-Round Knockout is what people say"...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: "But just three bowls will leave you in dismay"...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Hmm...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So far so good...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: The title is... "All in All, a Good Guy"

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: No good? Well, I did come up with another line, but I'm not sure how to continue it...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Perhaps you'd like to give it a go?

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: The first line I've come up with is "An indulgent bowl of rich rice wine"...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How about, "Topped with pearly white dumplings so fine."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Oh, that's quite good. How about the title?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "Extravagant but Elegant."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: "An indulgent bowl of rich rice wine, topped with pearly white dumplings so fine"... "Extravagant but Elegant"

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Not bad, not bad at all. You certainly have a talent for writing. Let me write this all on the lantern now...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: There! Now we're ready to give the lantern to Degui.

talks.objective: Give a Xiao Lantern to Degui

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: Ah, Linling. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Remember you asked me to write some lines for your Xiao Lantern? Well, the Traveler and I have just finished preparing everything.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: We've even written everything on the Xiao Lantern for you, so... Here you go.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: Oh, great! Thank you. Let me read what you've written here...

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: "An indulgent bowl of rich rice wine, topped with pearly white dumplings so fine"... "Extravagant but Elegant"...

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: It reads quite nicely, yes... Very nice, indeed. Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: You're very welcome. We have the Traveler to thank here for all the inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: By the way, I have another verse I came up with by myself that I've written down on this note. You may read it later when you have the time.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: Sure! Thanks a lot, you two. I need to get back and look after my business now.

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: "Third-Round Knockout is what people say, but just three bowls will leave you in dismay"...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Alright, our next patron is Bibo, he also asked me to make him a Xiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: That's Bibo just up ahead, let's keep an eye on him from here.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Hmm, I've heard that he's always involved in some mysterious business, but he's quite a nice guy...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I've already come up with a verse that is suitable for him.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: "By day, he tends to his business like a crafty rat"...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: "But by night, you discover that he's not so bad."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Oh, and the title... "He's a Jolly Good Fellow."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: No good, huh? Well, this was the more complete version I was able to come up with... I have another one that's not quite finished yet.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: It's a little bit plain and could use some creative flair.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's hear it, I'll see what I can do...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Okay, here it goes: "With goods so fresh he sways to and fro..."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: "No one sells produce like ol' Bibo"...

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Oh! That's a good one, but how about a title?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How about "Bibo's Seaside Market"?

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: "With goods so fresh he sways to and fro. No one sells produce like ol' Bibo"... Titled "Bibo's Seaside Market."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: "By day, he tends to his business like a crafty rat. But by night, you discover that he's not so bad"... Titled "He's a Jolly Good Fellow."

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Hmm, now that I hear them side-by-side, I'm starting to think that yours sounds a bit better. My verse is a bit too vivid, not something you'd typically write on a Xiao Lantern.

response.speaker: Linling
response.text: Alright! Let me just write your verse on the lantern and we'll be ready to give it to him.

choices.text: No, I really don't think you...

talks.objective: Give a Xiao Lantern to Bibo

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Linling. Any progress on the lantern...?

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Don't worry, the Traveler and I have already taken care of it. Here you go!

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Oh, that didn't take you any time at all. Thank you, let me read what you've written on it...

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: "With goods so fresh he sways to and fro. No one sells produce like ol' Bibo." Not bad, that sounds just like me!

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: I have another verse here that I wrote too, you can have them both.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Another one? Let me see, hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: "By day, he tends to his business like a"... Hey! Wh—What are you tryna...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: What do you think? It's quite fitting, isn't it? If you like that one too, you could make another Xiao Lantern and write it on yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Bibo
dialogues.text: Ahem... No thanks! I must get going...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Well, that does it for all the Xiao Lanterns. Thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Everyone seemed to enjoy them. It seems you have a lot of literary skill, just like me.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: *sigh* There are not many in this city that could compose couplets with me like you just did.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: If you ever have the time, please feel free to visit me again. We can continue working on more poetry together.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, will do...

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Good. Now I just need to come up with something to write on my own lantern, hehe. I won't need your help this time though, I'll be able to manage it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Linling
dialogues.text: Oh, I nearly forgot... these are for you. Consider them a token of my appreciation. It was nice to have someone accompany me during the festival. Thanks again!

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: "Third-Round Knockout is what people say, but just three bowls will leave you in dismay"...

dialogues.speaker: Degui
dialogues.text: That's actually pretty good...
